title: Airbnb Sold Cereal for {fact1} a Box
description:
Why did Airbnb's founders sell breakfast cereal for {fact1} a box?
In 2008 investors turned the home-sharing start-up down, so its founders made election cereal, and it got them into Y Combinator.
